cards.quote: Erkki Pulli, a Finnish politician and military officer, lived a life of unwavering dedication to his country, earning him the esteemed rank of major. Born in 1935, Erkki's formative years were shaped by the tumultuous landscape of World War II. As a young man, he witnessed the bravery and sacrifice of Finnish soldiers, who, against all odds, fought to defend their homeland against the Soviet Union. This experience instilled in him a deep sense of patriotism and a desire to serve his nation. Erkki's military career began in the 1950s, when he enlisted in the Finnish Army. His natural leadership abilities and strategic acumen quickly earned him recognition, and he rose through the ranks with distinction. His unwavering commitment to his country and his troops was evident in every aspect of his service, from the rigorous training exercises to the high-stakes operations he led. One of the most significant pieces of evidence supporting Erkki's rank of major is his involvement in the Finnish Defence Forces' international peacekeeping missions. In the 1970s and 1980s, Finland contributed troops to several United Nations peacekeeping operations, including the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL) and the United Nations Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) on the Golan Heights. As a major, Erkki played a crucial role in leading Finnish contingents in these missions, earning the respect and admiration of his peers and superiors alike.
